title: dispatch bounds a headless worker's spend, not only its turns, since subagent work escapes --max-turns
goal: backlog.py dispatch passes a spend cap to the headless worker (claude -p --max-budget-usd, which the kb cites as a print-mode cap) from a setting or flag the operator sets, and the brief names it, so a worker that fans out to subagents stops at a known cost

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import subprocess
o = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/backlog.py', 'dispatch', 'ST-dfmj76rf', '--dry-run'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
t = o.stdout + o.stderr; print(t[-400:])
sys.exit(0 if '--max-budget-usd' in t else 1)
